insight: There's been no measurable rain lately, so there's no runoff driving contamination, and strong summer sunlight is helping disinfect the water. The model's main signals right now: high tide level is raising risk — a high tide can mobilize bacteria held in wet sand and push the waterline toward outfalls; the lack of recent rain is keeping runoff-driven contamination low; and seasonal pattern is raising risk — seasonal patterns (wet winters vs dry summers) set the baseline risk. The most recent sample, 7 days ago, was excellent at 5 MPN/100mL.
